name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, TLS, Fail2ban, firewall rules, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures authenticated Redis on port 6379, and manages Redis logging and configuration adjustments.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python, PostgreSQL, a virtual environment, repository checkout, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
